name: Angus McGregor
bio:
Angus's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his family's outback garage. He transitioned from fixing up old Holdens to a formal apprenticeship in composite materials, quickly mastering the art of carbon fiber and other advanced materials. His dedication and precise craftsmanship led him to Racing Start Academy, where he plays a vital role in ensuring the structural integrity and aerodynamic performance of the team's vehicles.

Driven by a relentless desire to push boundaries, Angus continuously seeks innovative solutions to improve vehicle performance. He's not afraid to experiment with new techniques and materials, always looking for that extra edge on the track. His colleagues appreciate his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality, making him a valuable asset to the team.

Angus's distinctive edge lies in his ability to balance cutting-edge technology with old-school ingenuity. He believes that the best solutions often come from a combination of modern science and hands-on experience, a philosophy he brings to every task he undertakes.

physical.description: A wiry build and focused gaze give him the air of someone constantly assessing structural integrity.
